mapper.select: SELECT 'crm.merge.customer' AS label_key, COUNT(*) AS total, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_customer t WHERE t.customer_id = #{targetId}) THEN COUNT(*) WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN COUNT(*) - 1 ELSE 0 END AS conflicts FROM crm_customer WHERE customer_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'crm.merge.contact', COUNT(*), 0 FROM crm_contact WHERE customer_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'crm.merge.lead', COUNT(*), 0 FROM crm_lead WHERE customer_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'crm.merge.followup', COUNT(*), 0 FROM crm_followup WHERE customer_id IN OR (target_type = 'CUSTOMER' AND target_id IN ) UNION ALL SELECT 'crm.merge.opportunity', COUNT(*), 0 FROM crm_opportunity WHERE customer_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'crm.merge.contract', COUNT(*), 0 FROM crm_contract WHERE customer_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'crm.merge.ticket', COUNT(*), 0 FROM crm_ticket WHERE customer_id IN
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_contact SET customer_id = #{targetId}, is_primary = 0 WHERE customer_id IN
UPDATE crm_lead SET customer_id = #{targetId} WHERE customer_id IN

UPDATE crm_followup SET target_id = CASE WHEN target_type = 'CUSTOMER' AND target_id IN THEN #{targetId} ELSE target_id END, customer_id = CASE WHEN customer_id IN THEN #{targetId} ELSE customer_id END WHERE customer_id IN OR (target_type = 'CUSTOMER' AND target_id IN )
UPDATE crm_opportunity SET customer_id = #{targetId} WHERE customer_id IN
UPDATE crm_contract SET customer_id = #{targetId} WHERE customer_id IN
UPDATE crm_ticket SET customer_id = #{targetId} WHERE customer_id IN
